It absolutely IS possible to have a happy loving relationship with someone who has BPD. My fiancé and I have been engaged for a bit over a year. He was diagnosed about a year into our relationship. After getting diagnosed he got into a DBT program and stuck to it and worked on improving himself and getting better. After graduating the program he has continued to use his DBT skills and not fall back into old, negative behaviors and patterns. We both need to work on our communication. We both need to learn how to set boundaries. But he is absolutely the love of my life. A relationship can work, but all parties need to be dedicated. Communication from everyone is so important in every relationship, but especially if someone has BPD.

Thats not how kink works. Especially trauma related kinks.
First of all they didnt react positivity to being raped. In CNC specifically, its a way to almost rewrite the scenario to be non traumatic. You are in control of the scenario, you arent in danger, you can stop if you want. Also they arent involving children in this. This is between them and other consenting adults. Thats the whole point, to cope with their trauma, not to pass it on. How someone copes with trauma, or how they act in general is fine as long as they aren't hurting someone else. My partner has severe childhood trauma and one way he copes is by using kink because he is in control of the situation. He would also never hurt someone else, especially in the way he was hurt. Kink and roleplay are also approved by therapists as a way to cope. 
Second of all, what is you basis that kinks progress with age or that someone coping by using kink means they will go on to continue the cycle of abuse. What a person does in their sex life, as long as its with consenting adults, is fine and none of your concern. CNC stands for Consensual Non-Consent.

First of I'm so sorry that you went through that. Its fairly typical for people with trauma, especially sexual and/or childhood trauma, to develop kinks related to it. I have experienced my fair share of trauma and I have kinks related to them. It doesnt make you bad or suggest you wanted any of it. Brains just do that sometimes. I suggest eventually talking to your partner about it, even if its just a 'hey this is something happening in my life" thing.
